literal: Good conduct possession [is] noble birth; lapse [from it] degraded birth having become will end up.
translation: Possessing good conduct is true noble birth. Lapsing from it will result in a degraded birth.
modern: நல்லொழுக்கம் உடையவராக இருப்பதே உயர்ந்த குடிப்பிறப்பு ஆகும். அந்த ஒழுக்கத்திலிருந்து தவறுவது இழிவான பிறப்பாக முடிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: The couplet redefines what it means to be of noble birth. It states that true nobility comes solely from possessing good conduct. Conversely, any lapse from this proper conduct reduces a person's status. Such a failure will end up making them someone of degraded birth. Thus, character and behavior, rather than mere lineage, determine a person's true worth.
